title: ERC20 tokens without return value will DoS reward claiming
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Several functions throughout the application use the `transfer` function to transfer ERC20 tokens. However, some tokens do not return a `bool` on transfer, and since the ERC20 interface expects the `bool` return value, calling `transfer` on tokens that do not return a `bool` would revert.
